#.label: Adyen local terminals (preview)
Tell a checkout which Adyen terminal to: Tell a checkout which Adyen terminal to use. Use the target finder at the top to pick one checkout, because each checkout has its own terminal. A value set on a store, a group or the tenant would apply to every checkout below it, which you almost never want. The shared settings come from “Payments – Adyen local settings”.
#/properties/terminalId.label: Terminal ID
#/properties/terminalId.description: Adyen's ID for the terminal at this checkout, for example e285p-123456789, as shown in your Adyen customer area.
#/properties/terminalIpAddress.label: Terminal IP address
#/properties/terminalIpAddress.descripti: The terminal's address on the store network, for example 192.168.1.100. Give the terminal a fixed address, so the checkout can always find it.
